{{nowrap|[[South Kent School|South Kent]] ([[South Kent, Connecticut]])}} | college = | draft_year = 2013 | draft_round = TBD | draft_pick = TBD | draft_team = | career_start = | career_end = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = }} '''Ricardo "Ricky" Ledo''' (born September 10, 1992){{cite web| last =Visenberg| first =Michael| title =Ricardo Ledo| work =NBADraft.net| publisher =Sports Phenoms, Inc.| date =May 27, 2013| url =http://www.nbadraft.net/players/ricardo-ledo| accessdate =June 12, 2013}} is an American basketball player who is a projected draft pick in the [[2013 NBA Draft]]. He committed to play for the [[Providence Friars men's basketball|Providence Friars]], but the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association]] (NCAA) ruled him academically ineligible to play during his freshman season in [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2012–13]].{{cite web| last =Lombardi| first =Matt| title =Providence’s Best Recruit In Years, Ricky Ledo, Declares For The NBA Without Even Playing A Game For The Friars| publisher =College Spun| date =April 11, 2013 | url =http://collegespun.com/big-east/providence/providences-best-recruit-in-years-ricky-ledo-declares-for-the-nba-without-even-playing-a-game-for-the-friars#| accessdate =June 13, 2013}} Ledo never played a minute for the Friars that season, and at the end of the year he declared he was entering the [[NBA Draft]].{{cite web | title =Ricky Ledo didn't play a game at Providence last year, still among top point guards in draft| publisher = FOX News Network, LLC.| date =June 4, 2013| url =http://www.foxnews.com/sports/2013/06/04/ricky-ledo-didnt-play-game-at-providence-last-year-still-among-top-point-guards/| accessdate = June 10, 2013}} ==High school== During his high school career, Ledo attended [[St. Andrew's School (Rhode Island)|St. Andrew's School]] in [[Barrington, Rhode Island]], [[Notre Dame Preparatory School (Fitchburg, Massachusetts)|Notre Dame Preparatory School]] in [[Fitchburg, Massachusetts]], and [[South Kent School]] [[South Kent, Connecticut]].{{cite web| last =Farrahar| first =Kevin| title =Breaking Down Ricky Ledo| work =Friar Basketball| publisher =Wordpress| date =June 2, 2013| url =http://friarbasketball.com/2013/06/breaking-down-ricky-ledo/| accessdate = June 13, 2013}} At St. Andrew's, Ledo's squad finished second in the NEPSAC Class B conference; at Notre Dame, he led the team to the Prep National Finals; and, at South Kent, he was a Second Team All-Conference performer as a senior. ==College ineligibility== Ledo was rated the #21 overall college prospect by [[ESPN]] and was a McDonald's All-American.{{cite web| title =NBA Draft 2013: Ricky Ledo scouting report| work =SB Nation NBA News| publisher =Vox Media, Inc.| date =May 1, 2013| url =http://www.sbnation.com/2013/6/9/4403280/ricky-ledo-scouting-report-nba-draft-2013 |accessdate =June 13, 2013}} He committed to play for [[Providence College]] in his home state of Rhode Island. In September of his freshman year, the NCAA ruled him academically ineligible due to not having enough credits. He stayed at school with the hope that he would be eligible during the second semester, but the NCAA never reinstated him. ==Professional career== After spending one year at Providence without being able to play, Ledo declared for the [[2013 NBA Draft]]. Despite never playing a single game in his career with Providence, he is still credited by the NBA as a person that came out of Providence as opposed to high school. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Ricky-Ledo-6289/ Draft Express profile] {{Persondata | NAME = Ledo, Ricky | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = Ledo, Ricardo | SHORT DESCRIPTION = American basketball player | DATE OF BIRTH = September 10, 1992 | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ledo, Ricky}} [[Category:1992 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Rhode Island]] [[Category:Providence College alumni]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Providence, Rhode Island]]
